data.long_meaning: Avanish is derived from the Sanskrit words 'ava' meaning 'away' and 'nis' meaning 'to destroy'. This name signifies the removal of ignorance and the revealing of truth. In Hindu mythology, Avanish is also the name of a god associated with the destruction of illusions and the revelation of the true nature of reality.
